subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Few records exist of the life of Celine Alcide (1923–1995).
• She was born in rural Mexico and gained regional recognition as a traditional folk singer and storyteller.
• She performed many memorable songs—some recorded and some known only through oral tradition.
• She has become a celebrated cultural icon thanks to her music being featured in dozens of documentaries, albums, and academic studies.
• In the 2018 documentary Voices of the Past, her haunting ballads are showcased as preserving centuries-old Mexican traditions.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the effect academic and media attention had on building Celine Alcide's legacy. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Though she was known regionally during her lifetime, Celine Alcide's later inclusion in documentaries, albums, and academic studies has turned her into a celebrated cultural icon.
choices.B: Thanks to her inclusion in dozens of academic studies and media productions, Celine Alcide was regionally known as a successful folk singer and storyteller.
choices.C: Various documentaries and academic studies have featured Celine Alcide, the traditional folk singer who became a celebrated cultural icon.
choices.D: Celine Alcide's abilities as a folk singer are featured in many academic works, including the 2018 documentary Voices of the Past.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes the effect academic and media attention had on building Celine Alcide's legacy, noting that scholarly and media coverage after her lifetime turned her into a celebrated cultural icon.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. While it appears to emphasize the effect of academic and media attention on Celine Alcide, the sentence misrepresents information from the notes. According to the notes, scholarly and media coverage resulted in her becoming a celebrated cultural icon, not a regionally known folk singer.
